sentences.en: Today, Mike Schmidt on how a single piece of unverified intelligence became the centerpiece of a Republican attempt to impeach President Biden.
sentences.zh: 今天，迈克·施密特讲述了一则未经证实的情报是如何成为共和党试图弹劾拜登总统的核心的。

sentences.en: And what happened once that intelligence was discredited?

sentences.en: It's Monday, March 4th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月4日，星期一。

sentences.en: So, Mike, if this is a story about a piece of intelligence and its journey through our government, I think we should start there with the piece of intelligence and the story
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克，如果这是一个关于一则情报及其在我们政府中流传过程的故事，我想我们应该从那则情报以及背后的故事开始

sentences.en: behind it.
sentences.zh: 背后的故事。

sentences.en: As you probably remember, heading into the 2020 election, Donald Trump rightly identified
sentences.zh: 正如你可能记得的那样，在临近2020年大选时，唐纳德·特朗普敏锐地认定

sentences.en: Joe Biden as his biggest political problem.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登是他最大的政治麻烦。

sentences.en: And he dispatched his personal lawyer, Rudy Giuliani, to dig up dirt on the Biden family.
sentences.zh: 他派出了他的私人律师鲁迪·朱利安尼去搜集拜登一家的黑料。

sentences.en: Giuliani went to Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 朱利安尼去了乌克兰。

sentences.en: He met with these officials and figures there.
sentences.zh: 他在那里会见了这些官员和人物。

sentences.en: And he came back and is basically like, Joe Biden's son's corrupt and Joe Biden is part of it and made such a fuss that the attorney general, Bill Barr, eventually asked a United
sentences.zh: 他回来后基本上说，乔·拜登的儿子很腐败，乔·拜登也牵涉其中，并且大做文章，以至于司法部长威廉·巴尔最终要求宾夕法尼亚州的一位

sentences.en: States attorney in Pennsylvania to essentially just deal with Rudy.
sentences.zh: 美国联邦检察官基本上只是去应付鲁迪。

sentences.en: Listen to what Rudy has to say.
sentences.zh: 听听鲁迪怎么说。

sentences.en: Find out if any of it is true.
sentences.zh: 查明其中是否有任何真实情况。

sentences.en: And if it is, pass it along to the investigators who should look at it.
sentences.zh: 如果有，就将其转交给应该调查它的调查人员。

sentences.en: I remember all this.
sentences.zh: 我记得这一切。

sentences.en: It was not about Hunter Biden so much as tying Joe Biden, his father, to his son's alleged corruption.
sentences.zh: 这与其说是关于亨特·拜登，不如说是要把乔·拜登——他的父亲——与他儿子涉嫌的腐败联系起来。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what we didn't know at the time was that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而我们当时不知道的是，美国

sentences.en: years earlier, an FBI informant told his handler that he had a contact at the Ukrainian energy company, Burisma, where Joe Biden's son, Hunter, was on the board.
sentences.zh: 几年前，一名联邦调查局（FBI）线人曾向他的联络人透露，他在乌克兰能源公司布里斯马（Burisma）有个人脉，乔·拜登的儿子亨特当时是该公司董事会成员。

sentences.en: On the board and very well paid.
sentences.zh: 在董事会任职而且薪酬丰厚。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 正确。

sentences.en: So that U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以那位美国

sentences.en: attorney asks that the FBI handler go back and ask the informant what he knows about Hunter Biden.
sentences.zh: 检察官要求FBI联络人回去询问线人关于亨特·拜登的情况。

sentences.en: And in response, the informant makes a very salacious allegation.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，线人提出了一个非常劲爆的指控。

sentences.en: Which is what?
sentences.zh: 是什么？

sentences.en: He says that Hunter Biden and his father each took five million dollars in bribes from Burisma.
sentences.zh: 他说亨特·拜登和他的父亲各自从布里斯马收受了五百万美元的贿赂。

sentences.en: And in exchange for that money, Joe Biden, in his position as vice president at the time, would protect Burisma from corruption investigations by a Ukrainian prosecutor.
sentences.zh: 作为对这笔资金的回报，时任副总统的乔·拜登将保护布里斯马免受乌克兰检察官的腐败调查。

sentences.en: In other words, Joe Biden took a politically motivated bribe.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，乔·拜登收受了出于政治动机的贿赂。

sentences.en: So this is the moment when this piece of intelligence we're talking about in this episode is born.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我们在本集中讨论的这则情报诞生的时刻。

sentences.en: And it's a bombshell that a senior American elected official, former vice president, has gone rogue and taken money from a foreign company asking him to protect it.
sentences.zh: 这是一个重磅炸弹：一位美国高级民选官员、前副总统竟然失控，收受了一家要求其提供保护的外国公司的钱。

sentences.en: I mean, a genuinely shocking claim.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个真正令人震惊的说法。

sentences.en: Well, it's potentially a bombshell or it's one person telling his FBI handler something he says he heard.
sentences.zh: 嗯，它可能是一个重磅炸弹，也可能只是一个人在向他的FBI联络人讲述他自称听到的事情。

sentences.en: It's what one informant relayed to the FBI.
sentences.zh: 这是一个线人向FBI转达的内容。

sentences.en: And this is really important.
sentences.zh: 这非常重要。

sentences.en: What we're looking at in this case is not some polished product that's been vetted and analyzed and put into the presidential daily briefing.
sentences.zh: 我们在这个案例中看到的并不是什么经过审查、分析并被写入总统每日简报的精炼成果。

sentences.en: What we're talking about in this case is information at the bottom rung of the ladder for the intelligence community.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里讨论的是情报界处于最底层的信息。

sentences.en: This is raw source reporting that rolls into the country's law enforcement and intelligence agencies from its sources and informants.
sentences.zh: 这是从其线人和情报来源涌入国家执法和情报机构的原始线索报告。

sentences.en: It's something more akin to rumor than a corroborated piece of intel.
sentences.zh: 它更类似于谣言，而不是经过证实的的情报。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So what ends up happening to this piece of intelligence?
sentences.zh: 那么这则情报最后怎么处理了？

sentences.en: What happens is that that U.S.
sentences.zh: 结果是，那位

sentences.en: attorney who was sifting through these allegations about Hunter Biden closes his inquiry and sends the bribery allegation information to another United States attorney in Delaware who was investigating whether Hunter Biden should be charged for his taxes,
sentences.zh: 正在梳理这些关于亨特·拜登指控的美国检察官关闭了他的调查，并将贿赂指控的信息发送给特拉华州的另一位美国检察官，后者正在调查亨特·拜登是否应该为其税收问题、

sentences.en: his purchase of a gun and his foreign business dealings.
sentences.zh: 购买枪支以及海外商业交易受到指控。

sentences.en: And this is a big black hole in the story.
sentences.zh: 这是故事中的一个巨大黑洞。

sentences.en: We don't know what happens with this information other than the fact that it sits in the FBI's files.
sentences.zh: 除了这些信息存放在FBI的文件中之外，我们不知道它后来发生了什么。

sentences.en: And then Biden wins the presidency.
sentences.zh: 然后拜登赢得了总统大选。

sentences.en: And Republicans who want to take down the president and are still seeking revenge from the two impeachments of Trump want to find a link between Joe and his son.
sentences.zh: 而那些想要扳倒总统、并且仍在寻求对特朗普两次弹劾进行报复的共和党人，想要找到乔和他的儿子之间的联系。

sentences.en: But they can't.
sentences.zh: 但他们找不到。

sentences.en: And that's the case for three long years.
sentences.zh: 这种情况持续了整整三年。

sentences.en: Until late last spring.
sentences.zh: 直到去年春末。

sentences.en: Senator from Iowa.
sentences.zh: 来自艾奥瓦州的参议员。

sentences.en: When Chuck Grassley, the senator from Iowa, goes to the floor.
sentences.zh: 当来自艾奥瓦州的参议员查克·格拉斯利走上发言台时。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，总统先生。

sentences.en: And in multiple speeches, he says that whistleblowers have approached his office to tell him that the FBI has very damaging allegations on the Biden family.
sentences.zh: 他在多场演讲中表示，有吹哨人联系他的办公室，告诉他FBI掌握了关于拜登一家的非常具有破坏性的指控。

sentences.en: The allegations my office has received are very precise, very direct and very consistent.
sentences.zh: 我的办公室收到的指控非常精确、非常直接且非常一致。

sentences.en: Grassley says that this information is documented in a form that the FBI uses all the time called a 1023.
sentences.zh: 格拉斯利表示，这些信息记录在FBI经常使用的一种名为1023的表格中。

sentences.en: The 1023 that I sought from the FBI references a criminal scheme involving then-Vice President Biden and his alleged receipt of $5 million.
sentences.zh: 我向FBI索取的1023表格涉及一项犯罪计划，其中涉及当时的副总统拜登及其涉嫌收受500万美元。

sentences.en: He says that politics has infected the Bureau and that this information...
sentences.zh: 他说政治已经侵蚀了联邦调查局，而这些信息……

sentences.en: The FBI believes the source to be credible.
sentences.zh: FBI认为该消息来源是可信的。

sentences.en: Which was given to the FBI by a trusted informant.
sentences.zh: 这是由一个受信赖的线人提供给FBI的。

sentences.en: It's not being investigated.
sentences.zh: 目前没有在接受调查。

sentences.en: Did the FBI follow normal investigative processes and procedures?
sentences.zh: FBI是否遵循了正常的调查流程和程序？

sentences.en: Or did they just sweep this under the rug?
sentences.zh: 还是他们只是把这掩盖过去了？

sentences.en: And Congress and the American people need to see what this document says.
sentences.zh: 国会和美国人民需要看看这份文件写了什么。

sentences.en: Quit playing games and recognize who you work for.
sentences.zh: 别再玩把戏了，认清你到底为谁工作。

sentences.en: You're not working to protect the corporate interests of the FBI.
sentences.zh: 你不是为了保护FBI的机构利益而工作的。

sentences.en: You're working for the American people.
sentences.zh: 你是为美国人民工作的。

sentences.en: I yield.
sentences.zh: 我发言完毕。

sentences.en: And almost on cue, the conservative media goes nuts with it.
sentences.zh: 几乎是不受控制地，保守派媒体对此大肆炒作。

sentences.en: One of the FBI's top informants reported an allegation that Joe Biden took a $5 million bribe from a foreign national in exchange for a policy decision.
sentences.zh: FBI的顶级线人之一报告了一项指控，称乔·拜登为了换取某项政策决定，从一名外国国民那里收受了500万美元的贿赂。

sentences.en: This was not just any confidential human source, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这不仅仅是任何普通的机密人类情报来源。

sentences.en: It seems like that source was highly valued.
sentences.zh: 这个消息来源似乎受到了高度重视。

sentences.en: The new question is this.
sentences.zh: 新的问题是这样的。

sentences.en: Is Joe Biden still making good on the bribe?
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登还在兑现那笔贿赂的好处吗？

sentences.en: And we know the Democrat Party simply doesn't care if Joe Biden took millions in bribes.
sentences.zh: 我们知道民主党根本不在乎乔·拜登是否收受了数百万的贿赂。

sentences.en: There is no set of evidence that will ever be strong enough ever to get them to say enough.
sentences.zh: 没有任何证据能够强大到让他们说“够了”。

sentences.en: So as Grassley is making these claims, he and his allies in the House subpoena the document from the FBI.
sentences.zh: 因此，在格拉斯利发表这些言论的同时，他和众议院的盟友向FBI发出了传票，要求提供该文件。

sentences.en: There's a whole back and forth.
sentences.zh: 双方经过了一来回的交涉。

sentences.en: As the FBI warns Congress, look, this is unverified information that we have in our files.
sentences.zh: FBI警告国会，听着，这是我们档案中未经验证的信息。

sentences.en: We're not just going to hand this over to you.
sentences.zh: 我们不会就这样把它交给你。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But the Republicans keep the pressure on the FBI.
sentences.zh: 但共和党人继续向FBI施压。

sentences.en: They threaten to hold the FBI director, Chris Wray, in contempt.
sentences.zh: 他们威胁要以藐视国会罪起诉FBI局长克里斯·雷。

sentences.en: If he doesn't give them the document.
sentences.zh: 如果他不把文件交出来的话。

sentences.en: And in the face of that, Wray allows Congress to see a redacted copy of the document that shows what the informant told the handler.
sentences.zh: 面对这种情况，雷允许国会查看该文件被涂黑的副本，其中显示了线人对联络人所说的话。

sentences.en: This feels like an important moment because this is the FBI taking unverified intelligence and allowing it to enter the political sphere.
sentences.zh: 这感觉是一个重要的时刻，因为这是FBI将未经证实的情报并允许其进入政治领域。

sentences.en: I mean, let's be honest, the people demanding this document are not members of the House Intelligence Committee trying to better understand U.S.-Ukraine relations.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，坦白说，要求这份文件的人并不是众议院情报委员会中试图更好地理解美乌关系的成员。

sentences.en: They are pretty far-right conservatives who are openly seeking to find evidence against the president.
sentences.zh: 他们是相当极端的保守派，公开寻求寻找针对总统的证据。

sentences.en: And are doing this at the same time that the FBI is saying, look, all this document does is show what an informant told a handler.
sentences.zh: 他们这样做的时候，FBI却在说，看，这份文件所展示的仅仅是一个线人对联络人说的话。

sentences.en: It shouldn't be seen as anything more than that.
sentences.zh: 它不应被视为别的什么。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So what happens once these congressional Republicans get a glimpse of this document?
sentences.zh: 那么，一旦这些国会共和党人瞥一眼这份文件，会发生什么？

sentences.en: They come out in like an aha moment and say, we've got Joe Biden connected to his son's corruption.
sentences.zh: 他们像发现了新大陆一样走出来说，我们抓到了乔·拜登与他儿子的腐败相勾连的证据。

sentences.en: This is the biggest political corruption scandal, not only in my lifetime, but I would say the past 100 years.
sentences.zh: 这是不仅在我有生之年、而且可以说是一百年内最大的政治腐败丑闻。

sentences.en: The evidence is overwhelming.
sentences.zh: 证据确凿。

sentences.en: We're not talking about Republican partisan witnesses from some far-right-wing conspiracy.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的不是来自某些极右翼阴谋论的共和党党派证人。

sentences.en: We're talking about FBI informants, trusted FBI informants coming forth.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是FBI线人，受信任的FBI线人挺身而出。

sentences.en: And by September, with this bribery allegation as the centerpiece.
sentences.zh: 到了9月，随着这起贿赂指控成为核心。

sentences.en: That's why today I am directing our House committee to open a formal impeachment inquiry into President Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么今天我指示我们的众议院委员会对乔·拜登总统展开正式的弹劾调查。

sentences.en: Republicans move ahead with an impeachment inquiry into the president.
sentences.zh: 共和党人推进了对总统的弹劾调查。

sentences.en: The American people deserve to know that the public offices are not for sale.
sentences.zh: 美国人民理应知道公职不是用来买卖的。

sentences.en: And that the federal government is not being used to cover up the actions of a politically associated family.
sentences.zh: 联邦政府也没有被用来掩盖具有政治关联的家族的行为。

sentences.en: And it's important to note that beyond this bribery allegation, the Republicans don't have much.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，除了这起贿赂指控之外，共和党人并没有掌握太多东西。

sentences.en: We will go wherever the evidence takes us.
sentences.zh: 我们将跟随证据指引的方向前进。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重塑者》，这是一个专注于设计之爱及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 甚至在我还在黑胶时代夜店打碟的时候，你每天晚上都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去上班。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.

sentences.zh: 立即在您最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重塑者》。

sentences.en: I'm Wenna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是刘玟。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写了《纽约时报》游戏中的拼字游戏《同义连连》。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天创作《拼字蜜蜂》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: Like the ones you just heard from.

sentences.en: So with the stakes of this rising by the moment, we're now talking impeachment in the House,
sentences.zh: 随着事态的分量每分每秒都在增加，我们现在在众议院讨论弹劾问题，

sentences.en: how, Mike, do we come to understand that this salacious bombshell claim was not, in fact, true?
sentences.zh: 迈克，我们怎么会了解到这个耸人听闻的重磅炸弹爆料事实上并非如此呢？

sentences.en: So in the wake of the Republicans kicking up all this stuff about the allegation, that U.S.
sentences.zh: 因此，在共和党人挑起关于这一指控的种种风波之后，美国

sentences.en: attorney in Delaware finally goes and investigates it.
sentences.zh: 特拉华州的检察官终于去进行了调查。

sentences.en: Takes that allegation of bribery that perhaps has been sitting around his office and says,
sentences.zh: 他拿起那个可能一直搁置在他办公室里的行贿指控，然后说：

sentences.en: I'm going to figure out whether this is real.
sentences.zh: 我要弄清楚这到底是真是假。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So working with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因此，联邦调查局（FBI）的联络员与美国

sentences.en: attorney, the FBI handler goes back to the informant to talk about the allegation.
sentences.zh: 检察官合作，回去找线人谈论这个指控。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: To see what else is there.
sentences.zh: 看看还能查出什么。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And the Justice Department starts to have doubts about the accuracy of his story.
sentences.zh: 司法部开始对其说辞的准确性产生怀疑。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: What explains that?
sentences.zh: 这该如何解释？

sentences.en: Well, let me tell you a little bit about who the informant is.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我向你简要介绍一下这个线人是谁。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: The informant is a guy in his early 40s named Alexander Smirnoff.
sentences.zh: 这个线人是一个四十岁出头的男子，名叫亚历山大·斯米尔诺夫。

sentences.en: He's been living in the U.S., and he's been an FBI informant for over a decade.
sentences.zh: 他一直在美国生活，做FBI的线人已经超过十年了。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: In that role, he's provided information to the Bureau that led to criminal investigations.
sentences.zh: 在这个角色中，他曾向局里提供过促成刑事调查的情报。

sentences.en: And even more, he's received special dispensation from the FBI to go out and conduct criminal activity as he gets information for the Bureau.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，他还获得了FBI的特别特许，可以在为局里搜集情报的同时外出从事犯罪活动。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So he's a valuable source.
sentences.zh: 所以他是一个很有价值的消息源。

sentences.en: Why does the Justice Department suddenly have doubts about him?
sentences.zh: 为什么司法部突然对他产生怀疑？

sentences.en: Because his story is not holding up to scrutiny.
sentences.zh: 因为他的说辞经不起推敲。

sentences.en: Smirnoff had said that he learned about the allegation in 2015 or 2016, but he actually hadn't been talking to anyone at Burisma until 2017,
sentences.zh: 斯米尔诺夫曾表示，他在2015年或2016年得知了这一指控，但实际上他直到2017年才与布里斯马公司的任何人交谈过，

sentences.en: after Joe Biden had left office as vice president.
sentences.zh: 当时乔·拜登已经卸任副总统。

sentences.en: He also said he saw footage of Hunter Biden entering a hotel in Ukraine and that there were audio recordings of Hunter talking about the bribe.
sentences.zh: 他还声称自己看到了亨特·拜登进入乌克兰一家酒店的录像，并且有亨特谈论行贿的录音。

sentences.en: But Hunter hadn't been to Ukraine at that point.
sentences.zh: 但亨特当时根本没有去过乌克兰。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So these inconsistencies were really alarming to the FBI.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些矛盾之处确实让FBI感到警惕。

sentences.en: And on top of that, the informant is telling his handler about how much he doesn't like Joe Biden and how much Joe Biden's ties to Ukraine are going to take down his presidency.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，这个线人一直在向他的联络员表达他对乔·拜登的极度厌恶，以及乔·拜登与乌克兰的联系将如何毁掉他的总统任期。

sentences.en: And perhaps even more troublingly, the informant tells the FBI that he's recently been in touch with Russian intelligence officials who have been feeding him their own information,
sentences.zh: 或许更令人不安的是，线人告诉FBI，他最近一直在与俄罗斯情报官员接触，这些人一直在向他喂食他们自己的情报，

sentences.en: including some on Hunter Biden.
sentences.zh: 其中包括一些关于亨特·拜登的情报。

sentences.en: In other words, the informant might be a Russian asset, might be doing the bidding of the Russian government,
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这个线人可能是一个俄罗斯资产，可能在听从俄罗斯政府的差遣，

sentences.en: which has a long history of trying to feed misinformation into the American political system.
sentences.zh: 而俄罗斯长期以来一直有向美国政治系统注入虚假信息的历史。

sentences.en: We learned that, of course, in 2016.
sentences.zh: 我们在2016年当然就领教过了。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So ultimately, Mike, what conclusion does the FBI and this U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以归根结底，迈克，FBI和这位美国

sentences.en: attorney draw about this informant when they go back and start finding all these inconsistencies and problems?
sentences.zh: 检察官在回过头来发现所有这些矛盾和问题时，对这个线人作出了什么结论？

sentences.en: That he can't be trusted about anything and that he fabricated the bribery claim.
sentences.zh: 那就是他关于任何事情都不可信，行贿指控是他捏造的。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: We learn all this because something extraordinary and unusual happens.
sentences.zh: 我们之所以了解到这一切，是因为发生了一件非同寻常的事情。

sentences.en: The Justice Department, just a couple of weeks ago, indicts the informant for lying to the FBI.
sentences.zh: 就在几周前，司法部以向FBI说谎的罪名起诉了该线人。

sentences.en: And now he's sitting in jail awaiting trial.
sentences.zh: 现在他正坐在监狱里等待审判。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: You said that arresting this informant was unusual.
sentences.zh: 你刚才说逮捕这个线人很不寻常。

sentences.en: So why does the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么为什么美国

sentences.en: government charge the informant?
sentences.zh: 政府要指控这个线人？

sentences.en: What's unique here is that the government usually doesn't charge informants.
sentences.zh: 这里独特的地方在于，政府通常不会起诉线人。

sentences.en: Informants are not nuns and priests.
sentences.zh: 线人可不是修女和神父。

sentences.en: They're people that are playing in the dirty parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 他们是在世界上黑暗地带厮混的人。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Sometimes they tell the truth.
sentences.zh: 有时他们说实话。

sentences.en: Sometimes they shade it.
sentences.zh: 有时他们有所保留。

sentences.en: Sometimes they make things up.
sentences.zh: 有时他们胡编乱造。

sentences.en: And in that, at times, are really important kernels that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而在其中，有时包含着美国

sentences.en: government has to learn about.
sentences.zh: 政府必须了解的重要核心内容。

sentences.en: And if you charge informants, you're going to deter other informants from talking to the bureau because they know, oh, man, if I make a mistake, I, too, make it charge myself.
sentences.zh: 如果你起诉线人，就会阻吓其他线人与联邦调查局交谈，因为他们会想：天哪，如果我犯了错，我自己也会遭到指控。

sentences.en: So should we understand the fact that the government charges this informant as perhaps a measure of just how offended they were by the nature of the lies he told and based on the fact that it contributes to an impeachment inquiry,
sentences.zh: 那么，我们是否应该将政府起诉这个线人这一事实理解为一种衡量标准，表明他们对他的谎言性质感到多么愤怒，并且基于这样一个事实：这助长了一场弹劾调查，

sentences.en: the oversized impact that it had?
sentences.zh: 以及它所产生的过大影响？

sentences.en: I don't know, but I think you might be right.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，但我认为你可能是对的。

sentences.en: This is something that was weaponized by a political party and used essentially as the centerpiece of an impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 这是被一个政党武器化并实质上用作弹劾调查核心的东西。

sentences.en: And the weight of that lie, the importance of it was more than just your average allegation.
sentences.zh: 那个谎言的分量、它的重要性不仅仅是一般的指控。

sentences.en: And I don't know that that is the reason that they did this, but certainly it's hard to not think that it contributed to it in some way.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这是否是他们这样做的原因，但当然很难不去想它在某种程度上起到了推动作用。

sentences.en: Mike, I think it's worth just pausing and reflecting on what you just told us.
sentences.zh: 迈克，我认为值得停下来思考一下你刚才告诉我们的内容。

sentences.en: Because what the journey of this piece of intelligence tells us is that House Republicans and to a degree, Senate Republicans, Chuck Grassley,
sentences.zh: 因为这条情报的发展历程告诉我们，众议院共和党人，在某种程度上还有参议院共和党人查克·格拉斯利，

sentences.en: took a single strand of raw intelligence that they had been told was never verified and they ran with it in the biggest way possible.
sentences.zh: 抓住了一条他们被告知从未得到过证实的原始情报线索，并以最大可能的规模大加炒作。

sentences.en: They made it a centerpiece of their efforts to link a sitting president with the foreign business dealings of his son, claimed it represented corruption,
sentences.zh: 他们把它作为努力将现任总统与其儿子的海外商业交易联系起来的核心，声称这代表着腐败，

sentences.en: and they made it the centerpiece of their efforts to impeach Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 并将其作为他们弹劾乔·拜登努力的核心。

sentences.en: And now we know that the government regards that information as a fabrication and the informant who delivered it as a serial liar.
sentences.zh: 现在我们知道，政府认为该信息是伪造的，提供该信息的线人是个惯犯。

sentences.en: That's a pretty remarkable story.
sentences.zh: 这是一个相当引人注目的故事。

sentences.en: It's extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 这非同寻常。

sentences.en: And it's also not how the system is supposed to work.
sentences.zh: 而且这也是不符合系统运作规律的。

sentences.en: Intelligence is not supposed to be harnessed by politicians to knock off their enemies.
sentences.zh: 情报本不该被政客们利用来打击政敌。

sentences.en: It's supposed to be there to inform decision makers as they look at this crazy, big, confusing world and try to make the right call.
sentences.zh: 它的存在应该是为了在决策者审视这个疯狂、巨大、混乱的世界并试图做出正确决定时提供信息。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, like you said, in every way, this seems to be a case study of how intelligence is not properly handled in our system.
sentences.zh: 所以，就像你说的，在各方面这似乎都是一个关于我们的系统如何未能正确处理情报的案例研究。

sentences.en: And I wonder, therefore, what the larger lesson of this is.
sentences.zh: 因此我想知道，这带给我们更广泛的教训是什么。

sentences.en: I mean, is it about picking better informants?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是关于挑选更好的线人吗？

sentences.en: Is it about running intelligence down better, making sure you figure out if something's true and don't just lock it away in a file cabinet?
sentences.zh: 是关于更好地深挖情报、确保弄清某事是否属实而不是仅仅把它锁在档案柜里吗？

sentences.en: Is it about never giving it to lawmakers who could abuse it?
sentences.zh: 是关于绝不把它交给可能滥用它的议员吗？

sentences.en: I mean, what is the meaning of this story?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这个故事的意义何在？

sentences.en: I think it's about being humble to the fact that just because one person said something doesn't necessarily mean it's true.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是要保持谦逊，认识到仅仅因为某个人说了一句话并不一定意味着它是真的。

sentences.en: And that when we hear things, that there's a bit of skepticism that not everything that is recorded by the government or said publicly is true.
sentences.zh: 并且当我们听到事情时，要抱有一点怀疑态度，并非政府记录或公开说出的每件事都是真的。

sentences.en: And that we have to have some humility to the fact that this is a really, really complex, crazy world.
sentences.zh: 我们必须对这是一个非常、非常复杂、疯狂的世界这一事实保持一些谦逊。

sentences.en: And not every disclosure answers the major questions of the moment.
sentences.zh: 并非每一次披露都能解答当下的重大问题。

sentences.en: And I think that in a time where there's a ton of uncertainty, people grasp for these things and they try to use them to make their point.
sentences.zh: 我认为在一个充满不确定性的时期，人们会抓住这些东西，并试图用它们来证明自己的观点。

sentences.en: But at the end of the day, it may not be true.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，它可能并非事实。

sentences.en: So that, of course, brings us to the question of where this all leaves this impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 所以，这自然把我们带到了这样一个问题：这一切让这场弹劾调查处于什么境地。

sentences.en: I mean, the foundation of it, the missing link, the alleged smoking gun, you know, evaporates and its source is branded a serial liar and fabricated by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它的基础、缺失的环节、所谓的确凿证据，你知道的，烟消云散了，而它的来源被美国政府打上惯骗的烙印并被认定是捏造的。

sentences.en: government.
sentences.zh: 政府。

sentences.en: Does that kneecap the Republicans' impeachment process?
sentences.zh: 这是否削弱了共和党人的弹劾进程？

sentences.en: The hardline Republicans have said, this indictment, it's just the next part of the cover-up.
sentences.zh: 强硬派共和党人已经表示，这份起诉书只是掩盖真相的下一步。

sentences.en: It's just the next way that the FBI is doing the bidding of the Biden crime family.
sentences.zh: 这只是FBI为拜登犯罪家族效劳的又一种方式。

sentences.en: So you're saying many of the Republicans who first relied on this now false intelligence are undeterred by the fact that it has been branded fake by the government.
sentences.zh: 所以你是说，许多最初依赖这份现已被证明是虚假的情报的共和党人，并没有因为政府给它贴上假情报的标签而受到震慑。

sentences.en: And are now also claiming that this allegation was not that central to the impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 现在他们还声称这一指控对弹劾调查并没有那么核心。

sentences.en: But it was.
sentences.zh: 但它确实是。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: If you are a foreign government who wishes America ill, if you are Russia, you have to be watching all this and kind of licking your chops, right?
sentences.zh: 如果你是一个对美国怀有恶意的外国政府，如果你是俄罗斯，你一定在看着这一切并暗自窃喜，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, whether or not Russia fed this informant misinformation about a bribe involving Hunter and Joe Biden,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，无论俄罗斯是否向这个线人喂食了关于涉及亨特和乔·拜登受贿的虚假信息，

sentences.en: the journey of this piece of intelligence suggests that feeding misinformation into our system is still a very reliable way to wreak havoc in the United States political system.
sentences.zh: 这条情报的发展历程表明，向我们的系统输入虚假信息仍然是在美国政治系统中制造混乱的非常可靠的方法。

sentences.en: It's not the first time we've learned that lesson, but it's an incredibly vivid example that it still could do a tremendous amount of damage.
sentences.zh: 这已经不是我们第一次吸取这个教训了，但这是一个极其生动的例子，证明它仍然可以造成巨大的破坏。

sentences.en: It almost seems too easy for our adversaries.
sentences.zh: 对我们的对手来说，这似乎太容易了。

sentences.en: You think of intelligence operations as these really complex things that involve gadgets and double agents.
sentences.zh: 你以为情报行动都是那种涉及高科技小玩意和双重间谍的极其复杂的事情。

sentences.en: But to get the United States ramped up and huffing and puffing.
sentences.zh: 但要让美国人情绪高涨、大发雷霆，

sentences.en: And impeaching its president.
sentences.zh: 并弹劾他们的总统。

sentences.en: You really just need to feed one side something that fits their narrative.
sentences.zh: 你真的只需要向其中一方喂食符合他们叙事的东西。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And they follow it out the window.
sentences.zh: 然后他们就会顺着杆子爬。

sentences.en: Well, Mike, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，迈克，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, Donald Trump won three more nominating contests in Michigan, Missouri and Idaho, doubling his delegate count and making clear that his last remaining rival,
sentences.zh: 周末，唐纳德·特朗普在密歇根州、密苏里州和爱达荷州又赢得了三场党内初选，使其代表票数翻倍，并明确表明他仅存的对手

sentences.en: Nikki Haley, has no real path forward.
sentences.zh: 妮基·黑利已经没有真正的前进道路了。

sentences.en: So far, Haley has won just a single primary, the District of Columbia.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，黑利只赢得了一场初选，即哥伦比亚特区。

sentences.en: Trump is expected to officially clinch the Republican nomination by the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 预计特朗普将在本月底前正式锁定共和党总统候选人提名。

sentences.en: And.
sentences.zh: 还有。

sentences.en: LeBron dribbles at Porter, sizes him up, 360, spin to the rim, head in.
sentences.zh: 勒布朗运球面对波特，打量着他，360度转身杀向篮筐，球进了。

sentences.en: There it is, 40,000.
LeBron makes history.
sentences.zh: 勒布朗创造了历史。

sentences.en: LeBron James has become the first player in NBA history to score 40,000 career points after making a left-hand layup during the L.A.
sentences.zh: 在周六洛杉矶湖人队对阵丹佛掘金队的比赛中，勒布朗·詹姆斯通过一记左手上篮，成为了NBA历史上第一位职业生涯得到40,000分的球员。

sentences.en: Lakers matchup against the Denver Nuggets on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 湖人队对阵丹佛掘金队的比赛中。

sentences.en: The milestone may help to settle a long-running debate over who is the greatest NBA player of all time.
sentences.zh: 这一里程碑可能有助于平息关于谁是NBA历史最佳球员的长期争论。

sentences.en: James, the Times wrote, is now, quote, all by himself in the annals of basketball history.

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎进来了一群自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱有时甚至惊心动魄的斗争中。
